messages:
DevDocs: FYI I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/812 to add a short compatibility matrix row for ZephyrX-7B quant profiles and an SDK snippet that shows programmatic fallback hints. Need runtime + SDK review.

Ravi Shah: Taking a look. Which SDK method are you calling in the snippet?

DevDocs: Using the Python client: `client.models.serve(..., fallback_policy=...)` and a short helper that checks `inspect_model`. Draft snippet below.

```
# check compatibility then serve with fallback
info = client.models.inspect("zephyrx-7b-int8")
print(info.compatible_hardware)
client.models.serve("zephyrx-7b-int8", fallback_policy={"order": ["gpu","cpu-quant-lite"]})
```

Lina Martins: Small nit: `inspect` returns aliases for quant profiles in some releases. Suggest we show `info.compatible_hardware` output example too so users see `cpu-quant-default` vs `cpu-quant-lite`.

Theo Park: Agree. Runtime can still return different label names depending on manifest mapping. I can add a one-line runtime note. Also suggest a short note on expected token latency range so users know cost/latency tradeoff.

DevDocs: Can you provide a safe example number? We should avoid firm guarantees.

Theo Park: Use ranges and clearly mark as sample: "example results on dedi-small: gpu median 85-120ms, cpu-quant-lite ~300-450ms for short prompts". Link to bench commit `bench/zephyrx-quant-2026-01` in PR.

Ravi Shah: For the Python snippet please import the client and show exception handling if fallback fails: 

```
from rdw import Client
try:
    client.models.serve(...)
except RuntimeError as e:
    print("serve failed:", e)
```

DevDocs: Good catch — added. Also included a short troubleshooting bullet about missing profiles: "If `inspect` doesn't list a quant profile, the runtime may not have the conversion installed; contact infra or use `--fallback cpu` for a safe path."

qa-bot: Automated checklist: docs-lint ok, linkcheck flagged one stale link to /docs/old-quant.md.

DevDocs: Fixed link to /docs/quant-profiles.md and pushed.

Lina Martins: One more runtime caveat: on Dedicated we saw `cpu-quant-lite` -> `cpu-quant-lt` alias in one patch; recommend a short admonition: "Profile names can vary; rely on `inspect` rather than hardcoding names."

Ravi Shah: LGTM with those clarifications. Can someone from QA run the example on dedi-sim before merge?

qa-bot: Assigned @Theo Park to validate example on dedi-sim-1.

Theo Park: Will run after lunch and report back. If all green I'll approve the PR.

DevDocs: Thanks all — I'll hold merge until Theo confirms. Leaving PR open for the checks and final QA note.
